title: No typo suggestion when two candidates are equally close
summary: nearest() keeps the first declared candidate at the lowest distance (strict `<`), so a token one edit from two known names suggests only the earlier one. The skill's Axiom 7 says a tie yields no hint or names both. Latent today: no current flag or subcommand pair creates a tie, and the bd-c98n additions add none (checked against KNOWN_CORE_FLAGS and KNOWN_SUBCOMMANDS).
